result_text:
I fixed the "past 90d" block. It now shows `loc90Days`, the main LOC of repositories with commits in the past 90 days. Before, the displayed figure was `loc180Days`. The fix is in `addBigRepositoriesSummary` in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/landscape/statichtml/LandscapeReportOverviewSection.java`. The count and percentage were already the 90-day values, so only that one variable changed.

I didn't compile or run any tests, so the change is untested.
